identity.paletteIntent: Black, charcoal and warm amber from the archival film, ending in muted forest green.
identity.typographyIntent: Anton theatrical display headings; readable system sans-serif narrative; bold primary-source labels.
identity.shapeLanguage: Wide film frames, full portraits and spare straight-edged source controls.
identity.densityRhythm: Thirty-second opening followed by short scenes; the river slows the pace before the conservation epilogue.
identity.archivalBehavior: Preserve authentic faces and image structure. Identify posed photographs, retrospective memoirs and modern landscape footage.
identity.endingLanguage: Return explicitly to 1901–1909 and distinguish protected lands, national parks and the later National Park Service.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Approved Library of Congress photographs and Pathé film; amber title film treatment.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Black gradients join archival frames to the narrative without invented historical detail.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Plain film, sound, effects and source buttons with visible keyboard focus.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Portrait subjects occupy the right of desktop scenes; text follows below full frames on small screens.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Natural scroll reveals scenes; the film begins in black and the river darkens before a green epilogue.
